* '''Original''' ([[Changing The Odds (V) (Virtual Set 12)]]): the release sheet “Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates” (Players Committee, “Official text as of January 9, 2007”; PDF dated 10 January 2007; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007), page 3, slip 3 ([[:File:OVS12-03-Changing_The_Odds-slip-2007-01-09.png]]), in the Committee's Remaster template; game text as above.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the re-issued sheet (PDF dated 12 August 2008; headed “Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 20 February 2009), page 3, slip 3 ([[:File:OVS12-03-Changing_The_Odds-slip-2008-08-12.png]]). '''What changed:''' the words and numbers are unchanged; the credit line, printed in January 2007 sideways in the slip's side margins (“Original concept by Evan Fitzgerald” / “PC Volunteer Award 2005”), now runs along the bottom of the text box as one line: “Original concept by Evan Fitzgerald     PC Volunteer Award 2005”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
